clause_evidence.clause: PMJDY provides universal banking services for unbanked households.
PMMY, under the same Ministry of Finance, provides micro-credit for income-generating micro-enterprises.
MGNREGA guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment to qualifying rural households.
PMAY-G, under the same Ministry of Rural Development, supports pucca houses with basic amenities for eligible rural households.
PM SVANidhi offers street vendors collateral-free working-capital loans, interest subsidy, and digital-payment incentives.
PMAY-U, under the same Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, provides housing support for eligible urban households.
PMKVY Recognition of Prior Learning certifies candidates’ existing skills.
PMKVY Short-Term Training, under the same Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, provides fresh skilling, reskilling, or upskilling.
Ujjwala 2.0 added 1.6 crore LPG connections with a special facility for migrant households.
Its predecessor, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, sought to replace traditional cooking fuels with LPG access for rural and deprived households.
APY offers guaranteed monthly pension options after age 60.
PMJJBY, associated with the same Department of Financial Services, provides life cover for death due to any reason.
